title: Bonsai
tagline: Grow, prune and wire a tiny tree toward a classic style.
description: A young tree grows through the four seasons while you watch where each branch is heading. Snip, pinch and wire it toward a named style, choose a pot, and let the judge score balance, taper and negative space. Lessons, hints, and Watch and Learn show how it is done. No timer pressure, no ads.
howToPlay: Pick a tree and read its style goals.
Choose Snip, Pinch or Wire, then touch the tree.
Watch the dotted lines to see where tips are heading.
Take wire off when its ring turns green.
Choose a pot and be judged for up to three stars.
